system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Mountain King Style

Cost: 1-2 Focus

You hurl your enemies like thrown rocks.

As an Action, spend -1 Focus and make a Melee or Ranged Weapon attack on a target creature within range. If your attack hits and deals Damage, the target is pushed away from you by a number of Spaces equal to your Training in Melee or Ranged Weapons, depending on which you used for the attack.

If the target hits an obstacle of its Size or larger, it is knocked Prone.

Enhancement. You may spend an additional -1 Focus when you activate this ability. If you do so, the distance of the push is doubled.
